paragraphs.text: at NN/g ran a clean test: 120 generated respondents against a question 604 real people had already answered. The headline conclusion matched. But the answers barely varied, and the variance is the whole point of research.

shipped Specs on October 15, Markdown right on the canvas. I like it. Agent briefs mostly live in files on someone’s laptop, and a spec can keep the decision next to the frame it’s about. It still needs someone in the room willing to push back on it.
calls most AI rollouts a farce, the same mistake he wrote about in 2014. Companies buy the technology and skip the people who have to use it. Twelve years later, it’s still true.
The useful part of research is the disagreement. Go find it, and write it down.
